name: stockmarket
description: - Fetches price history for **any Indian (`.NS`/`.BO`) or foreign stock** in its native currency (yfinance) - Detects **external factors** affecting price: news sentiment spikes, unusual volume, and divergence from the sector/market index - Runs **three forecasting models** (ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM) so you can compare classical vs deep-learning approaches — plus a RandomForest **up/down direction classifier** with backtest accuracy - React dashboard shows factors as **clickable markers directly on the price graph**, plus full cards below it
